This post explores the Palmer Penguins dataset using R. 

Data: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/), Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.

## Setup
We load the necessary libraries, suppressing startup messages and warnings.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

```{r}
clean_penguins <- penguins |> drop_na()
head(clean_penguins)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-penguin-bills
#| fig-cap: "Scatterplot of bill length vs. bill depth by species."
ggplot(clean_penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Bill Length (mm)", y = "Bill Depth (mm)")
```
